description: This file defines the HibernateLocationDAO class which implements LocationDAO interface, providing database access methods for Location entities, including CRUD operations, querying by various filters, and handling associated entities like LocationTag and LocationAttributeType.

classes.name: HibernateLocationDAO
classes.description: Implements LocationDAO to handle database operations related to Location entities using Hibernate ORM. Includes methods for CRUD, queries, and associated entities.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory for database sessions.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Saves or updates a Location, handling child location collection updates.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a Location by its ID.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a Location by its name.

methods.name: getAllLocations
methods.description: Returns all locations, including or excluding retired ones based on parameter.

methods.name: deleteLocation
methods.description: Deletes a Location from the database.

methods.name: saveLocationTag
methods.description: Saves or updates a LocationTag.

methods.name: getLocationTag
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationTag by ID.

methods.name: getLocationTagByName
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationTag by its name.

methods.name: getAllLocationTags
methods.description: Returns all LocationTags, optionally including retired.

methods.name: getLocationTags
methods.description: Searches for LocationTags by a search string.

methods.name: deleteLocationTag
methods.description: Deletes a LocationTag.

methods.name: getLocationByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a Location based on its UUID.

methods.name: getLocationTagByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a LocationTag based on its UUID.

methods.name: getCountOfLocations
methods.description: Counts locations matching a name fragment and retired status.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Retrieves locations filtered by name, parent, attributes, retired status, and supports pagination.

methods.name: getRootLocations
methods.description: Returns root locations (no parent), filtered by retired status.

methods.name: getAllLocationAttributeTypes
methods.description: Returns all LocationAttributeType entries.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Fetches LocationAttributeType by ID.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches LocationAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: saveLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Saves or updates a LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: deleteLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a LocationAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Provides a LocationAttributeType by name.

methods.name: getLocationsHavingAllTags
methods.description: Finds locations that have all specified tags, excluding null tags.
